messages:
tess: Noticed a pattern in linkcheck failures after the markdown->html pipeline change. Anchors generated for headings with parentheses and spaces are getting percent-encoded (e.g., #getting started -> #getting%20started) while sidebar links use hyphenated slugs (#getting-started). Some pages render fine, others jump to top. ci-bot: [linkcheck] ⚠ 9 anchor mismatches. Example: /guides/auth#getting-started -> 404; job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/14200 ryan: Can you paste a sample of the generated header id vs the sidebar href? tess: In site/guides/auth/index.html we have `

Getting Started

` (note the raw text), and the nav rendered `Getting Started`. Browser requests `/guides/auth/#getting-started` -> server returns page with `id="Getting Started"` so fragment doesn't match. yun: Ah, our mdx plugin that preserves original casing and punctuation for IDs got re-enabled by accident in the last merge. Previously we slugified to lowercase-with-dashes. The new behavior keeps raw header text in id attributes, which breaks fragment matching.\ops: We also have a minor related issue: some generated links had an extra slash before the fragment (`/sdk/js/#install`) which some clients treat as a different resource and drop the fragment on redirect.\ryan: Two-step plan: 1) Hotfix CI to rewrite HTML ids to normalized hyphen slugs so linkcheck passes; 2) Revert the plugin change and add a regression test for slug behavior. I'll open a PR for the hotfix.\ci-bot: [deploy] Build failed (linkcheck) — https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/14200/job/7\ryan: Hotfix script I propose for the pipeline (one-liner): find site -name '*.html' -exec sed -i "s/id=\"\([A-Za-z0-9 _()]+\)\"/id=\"\L\1\E/; s/ /-/g" {} + (tested locally on a subset of files) yun: Please make the sed narrowly scoped to headings with spaces/uppercase so we don't mangle legitimate machine IDs. Also add a small unit test that asserts `## Getting Started` produces `id="getting-started"`. tess: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/781 — includes sed-based CI transform + unit test + ticket DOCS-420 to revert after a proper plugin fix. PTAL @yun @ops\ci-bot: [ci] Job 14218 started for PR 781\ops: For webserver safety, I'll add an nginx redirect rule to normalize `/anypath/#fragment` edge cases by returning canonical redirects only for known routes. That should avoid fragment loss for clients that trigger redirects.\ryan: After landing the CI hotfix and nginx rule on staging, linkcheck is green and anchors resolve on mobile and desktop. CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/14218/job/9 ✅ yun: I'll follow up with a PR to the mdx slugifier to restore deterministic slug output and add a suite of heading permutations (parentheses, punctuation, non-ascii). We'll revert the sed after that change lands. tess: Thanks team. Merging hotfix to unblock the release; keeping DOCS-420 open for the long-term plugin revert and tests. Closing thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
